tools.name: chat
tools.description: Run a chat completion on the Phase AI gateway, paid from the Phase API key or the wallet this server uses (free models cost nothing). Returns the answer, actual price, task id for the receipt and usage.

tools.name: embed
tools.description: Compute embeddings on the Phase AI gateway (paid from the Phase API key or the wallet).

tools.name: key
tools.description: Balance, daily cap and spend of the Phase API key this server pays with (key mode).

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List models of the Phase AI gateway with prices (USD per 1M tokens, fee per call) and layer (flagship | open | class | free).

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Get the price ceiling for a chat request without paying (the gateway's 402 quote).

tools.name: receipt
tools.description: Fetch the public receipt of a paid request by task id (model, provider, tokens, price, settlement tx, request/response hashes, signatures) and its Merkle proof once the weekly epoch is closed.

tools.name: session
tools.description: Saved chat sessions on the Phase AI gateway: create one (returns an id and a shareable /s/<id> link), read its thread, list the wallet's sessions (wallet mode only: signed with the wallet key, no transaction), or delete one. Pass the id as `session` to chat and the gateway carries the context betwee
